record.field: Post a one-line internal log note on the pinned record's chatter — no composer, no review.

Post a quick internal log note on the pinned record's chatter. Fast complement to `/reply` — no composer, no recipients, no review. Use this when the user just wants to capture a short note for the team. 1. Resolve the target record from the pinned record in `` (model + id). If still missing, call `ask_user` once for a record reference. 2. Take the user's text after `/log ...` as the note body. Do NOT rephrase, expand, or polish it; that is what `/reply` is for. If the user gave no text after the slash command, call `ask_user` once asking what to log. 3. Wrap the text as minimal HTML — `

…

` paragraphs only. No styles, no signature. 4. Call `call_method`: - `model`: target model - `method`: `message_post` - `ids`: `[]` - `kwargs`: - `body`: the HTML - `subtype_xmlid`: `mail.mt_note` - `message_type`: `comment` 5. Reply with one short confirmation line, e.g. `Logged on .` Stop. Do not open the record or call any other tool.
Schedule a follow-up activity (to-do, call, meeting, email) on the pinned record.

Schedule a `mail.activity` on the pinned record. Use when the user wants to create a follow-up todo, call, meeting, or email reminder tied to a record.
1. Resolve the target record from the pinned record in `<ui_ctx>` (model + id). If still missing, call `ask_user` once for a record reference. 2. Collect the activity details. If the user already gave them in their request, use those; for anything still missing, call `ask_user` ONCE with a single combined question covering the missing pieces (type, deadline, assignee, summary). Acceptable activity types: - To-Do → `mail.mail_activity_data_todo` - Call → `mail.mail_activity_data_call` - Meeting → `mail.mail_activity_data_meeting` - Email → `mail.mail_activity_data_email` Defaults if unspecified after asking once: type = To-Do, deadline = today + 3 days, assignee = current user (omit `user_id`), summary = short echo of the user's request. 3. Resolve the assignee: if a name was given, `search_read` `res.users` with `[('name','ilike',<name>)]` (fall back to `login`), limit 5. Pick the unique match; if more than one, call `ask_user` once with the candidate list. 4. Call `call_method`: - `model`: target model - `method`: `activity_schedule` - `ids`: `[<id>]` - `kwargs`: - `act_type_xmlid`: chosen xmlid - `date_deadline`: ISO date string `YYYY-MM-DD` - `summary`: short title - `user_id`: assignee id (omit to default to current user) - `note`: optional HTML, only if the user provided extra context 5. Reply with one short confirmation: `Scheduled <type> on <display_name> for <date>, assigned to <assignee>.` Stop. Do not open the record afterwards.
